content.text: Hi, I need help with a refund. The hair dryer I bought stopped working and I want my money back. My order number is ORD-1146. I already tried turning it on and off at the wall and it still won't work at all.

I'd be happy to help you with a refund for the hair dryer. Before I can proceed, I need to verify your identity first.

Could you please provide the email address associated with your order?
